description: This file defines a class 'VersionAwarePlacementDirector' implementing the 'IPlacementDirector' interface, used for custom placement logic in Orleans. It selects a silo based on interface version and random choice.

classes.name: VersionAwarePlacementDirector
classes.description: A custom placement director that chooses a silo based on interface version and load, with random selection among compatible silos.

methods.name: OnAddActivation
methods.description: Determines the target silo for activation based on interface version and load, returning a randomly selected compatible silo.
